svg.title: JP Prakash - Software Engineer and Frontend Developer
svg.desc: Hero banner: Jakkula Paavana Prakash, Software Engineer and Frontend Developer from Vijayawada, India, open to collaborations, sitting in a bean bag in a neon-lit night room. Cards show what he is working on now and life beyond code: games, anime, food, cycling and chess.
